name: web-dark-voice-mode-invitation-card-with-blue-icon-tiles-and-pill-button
title: Dark rounded card inviting to 'advanced AI Voice Mode' with two blue icon-tile features, a disclaimer and a big blue Start chatting pill
whatItIs: A charcoal rounded card on black with a centred bold white title, two rows each with a bright blue rounded-square icon (chat bubble, smile) and a bold feature name with a grey description, a small centred disclaimer with an underlined Learn more link, a full-width blue Start chatting pill and a plain white 'Maybe later'.
whatItMeans: Confident and friendly; one bright blue action on charcoal guides the choice.
techniques: List features with bright icon tiles.
Use a full-width blue pill for the primary action.
Give the secondary action as plain text.
bestFor: Dark cards with a single accent

vocabulary.definition: A rounded square holding an icon.
A low-emphasis action styled as plain text.
